env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Render is exported and forwards its type parameter to the comptime
# generic Show, so a caller in another package cannot instantiate it. The
# defining package fails at compile time (SPEC 2.5, T-205), logos eject
# refuses with the same text, and nothing reaches run time.
cd w
! logos build ./...
stderr 'lib[/\\]lib.lgo:11:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Render forwards type parameter T to comptime generic Show; a caller in another package cannot instantiate it'
! stderr 'panic'
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'lib[/\\]lib.lgo:11:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Render forwards type parameter T to comptime generic Show; a caller in another package cannot instantiate it'
! exists out

# The same rule holds when the comptime generic comes from another package.
cd ../v
! logos build ./fwd
stderr 'fwd[/\\]fwd.lgo:6:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Render forwards type parameter T to comptime generic Show'

# An unexported forwarding function still reads the option fields through
# both levels.
cd ../u
logos run .
stdout '^ada unset$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/twolevelopt

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

type Profile struct {
	Nick string?
	Tag  string?
}

func Render[T any](v T) string {
	return Show[T](v)
}

func Show[T any](v T) string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		const if f.Index != 0 {
			s = s + " "
		}
		s = s + Cell(v.[f])
	}
	return s
}

func Cell(v string?) string {
	return v ?? "unset"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/twolevelopt/lib"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	p := lib.Profile{Nick: "ada"}
	fmt.Println(lib.Render[lib.Profile](p))
}

-- v/go.mod --
module example.com/twolevelfwd

go 1.27

-- v/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

func Show[T any](v T) string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		s = s + f.Name
	}
	return s
}

-- v/fwd/fwd.lgo --
package fwd

import "example.com/twolevelfwd/lib"

func Render[T any](v T) string {
	return lib.Show[T](v)
}

-- u/go.mod --
module example.com/twolevelok

go 1.27

-- u/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Profile struct {
	Nick string?
	Tag  string?
}

func render[T any](v T) string {
	return show[T](v)
}

func show[T any](v T) string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		const if f.Index != 0 {
			s = s + " "
		}
		s = s + cell(v.[f])
	}
	return s
}

func cell(v string?) string {
	return v ?? "unset"
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(render[Profile](Profile{Nick: "ada"}))
}
